Quality lane review of the integrated B-137a change (managed cross-provider CLI runs + receipt-bound review evidence). Scope: code quality of git diff main...HEAD across the 46 changed non-test source files, focused on dead code, type safety, I/O-shell isolation, proof-metadata both-surface coverage, and the mandatory doc-promise-undelivered closing self-check. No blocking quality findings.

Mechanical verification performed: (1) `npx tsc --noEmit` clean for packages/main and packages/utils; (2) `npm --prefix packages/main run build` exit 0; (3) full aggregate `node packages/main/dist/tasks/managed-cross-provider-suite-smoke.js` PASS, covering provider-launch-owner-admission-suite plus managed-host-run-command, managed-host-run-process, managed-host-run-e2e, managed-review-evidence, proof-admissibility-registry, candidate-spec-routing, cross-host-review, and provider-codex smokes; (4) `node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs` -> "Process fact contract verified". Note: an initial suite run failed with `finding_resolve refused: dispatched role "lattice-review-quality" has no finding_resolve authority`; this was ambient environment leakage from this reviewer's own managed-review context (LATTICE_AGENT / LATTICE_MANAGED_HOST_RUN_ID / LATTICE_MANAGED_REVIEW_INVOCATION_FD), not a defect in the change. Re-running with those variables unset produced a clean PASS. Recorded as an observation about smoke hermeticity, not a finding.

Dead code: no unused imports or uncalled symbols introduced; no commented-out code blocks. `ManagedHostRunSpec.agyPrintTimeout` (managed-host-run.ts:341-358) is unreachable on every current path but is explicitly documented as such, including an in-place correction of the earlier incorrect F-106 claim by F-109. I independently verified the reasoning: runHostRun accepts `agy` as a recognised host (host-run.ts:1683-1690) but materializeLaunch throws for host==='agy' (host-run.ts:1629-1634) BEFORE materializeLauncherArgv, and `--print-timeout` exists only in the agy launcher spec (host-execution-readiness.ts:98-103), so codex/claude callers reaching substitution have no such flag. This is honest documented retention, not dead code presented as live. `removeManagedHostRunRuntime` is exported but consumed only internally by pruneExpiredManagedHostRuns (managed-host-run.ts:2446) — wider-than-necessary export visibility, cosmetic only, not raised as a finding.

Type safety: zero `as any`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, or eslint-disable added anywhere in the diff. No bare empty catch blocks. All eight comment-only catches (provider-process-registry.ts:224,328,389; managed-host-run.ts:1016,1019,1724; host-run.ts:1452,1468) are bounded cleanup/racing-reclaim paths whose comments accurately state why swallowing is correct; none hides an actionable error. One cosmetic redundancy: managed-host-run.ts:1698 tests `leader !== undefined` where the local `inspect` helper is typed `... | null`, so the check is unreachable-by-type; harmless and non-behavioural, not raised as a finding.

Proof-metadata review coverage (narrow both-surfaces correctness rule): managedEvidenceBinding is authored and validated across both evidence surfaces rather than only one. finding-verify.ts binds it into the signature domain for findings (lines 41,74-85) and for review passes (lines 435,465-486), and both strict-shape validators enforce mutual exclusion against nativeEvidenceBinding (lines 149,584). Critically for CHK-006:adversarial:2, import-time admission (handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:201 and core/managed-review-evidence.ts:419) and REVIEW-gate consumption (core/review-run.ts:1527) both route through the single shared verifyManagedReviewEvidence evaluator; there is no managed-review-only parallel evaluator or mirrored special case. receiptValid additionally requires state==='completed', replacementSafe===true, processCleanup.reaped===true and residualProcessGroup===false, so a non-terminal, unsafe, or residual-process run cannot yield gate-consumable evidence.

Closing self-check for promised-but-undelivered (mandatory): every `lattice` command newly promised in docs/host-run-usage.md — host_run, host_run_status, host_run_cancel, managed_review_evidence_import, doctor, usage_sweep, review_run_start — is present in packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts, as are managed_review_proposal_set and host_run_worker. Documented behavioural promises match implementation: the 30-second waitMs cap corresponds to MANAGED_HOST_RUN_STATUS_WAIT_MAX_MS with boundedManagedHostRunStatusWaitMs; the documented import precondition (completed + replacementSafe=true + reaped=true + residualProcessGroup=false) is exactly the receiptValid predicate; and every operator field the docs promise from doctor (worker heartbeat, provider progress mode/time, deadline, cancellation, residual, replacementSafe, retention) is rendered by renderManagedHostRunDoctorSection in handlers/doctor.ts. No doc-promise-undelivered condition found.

I/O shell isolation: not applicable in the bridge.ts sense for this CLI/core change; no shell-layer file imports fn.ts. Reviewed only changed files, not the whole repository.
